# CNV calls preparation

## Software requirments 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggpubr)
```

## 1. 


```{r}
CNV_genes <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_1_ena/03_CNV/pureCN_all_samples_CNA_genes.csv")

CNV_genes_sig <- CNV_genes %>% filter(type %in% c("AMPLIFICATION","DELETION" ))

CNV_genes_count <- CNV_genes_sig %>% group_by(gene.symbol) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

CNV_genes_count %>% filter(gene.symbol %in% GOI)

check <- CNV_genes_sig %>% filter(gene.symbol %in% GOI)
```

```{r}
# ccRCC mutational driver genes 
GOI_IntOGen <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/IntOGen_DriverGenes_CCRCC.tsv")
GOI <- GOI_IntOGen$Symbol #n = 44
```


```{r}
files <- list.files("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_1_ena/03_CNV/pureCN_raw/")
filenames <- str_replace(files[str_detect(files, "pureCN")], "pureCN_","")

CNV_arm_full <- foreach(file = filenames, .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  dir <- paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_1_ena/03_CNV/pureCN_raw/pureCN_", file, "/", file, "_loh.csv") 
  cur_out <- read_csv(dir)
  return(cur_out)
}
```

```{r}
CNV_arm_sum <- CNV_arm_full %>% mutate(chr_arm = paste0(chr, "_", arm), diff_bp = as.integer(end) - as.integer(start)) %>% group_by(Sampleid, chr_arm) %>% mutate(total_bp = sum(diff_bp)) %>% mutate(C_norm = C*(diff_bp/total_bp)) %>% summarise(C_norm = sum(C_norm)) %>% mutate(chr_arm_type = ifelse(C_norm >= 3, "gain", ifelse(C_norm < 2, "loss", "neutral")))
  
CNV_arm_sum %>% ungroup() %>% filter(chr_arm_type == "gain") %>% count(chr_arm) %>% arrange(desc(n))
CNV_arm_sum %>% ungroup() %>% filter(chr_arm_type == "loss") %>% count(chr_arm) %>% arrange(desc(n))
  

out_heat <- CNV_arm_sum %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = Sampleid, values_from = C_norm, names_from = chr_arm) %>% column_to_rownames("Sampleid")
out_heat <- out_heat %>% mutate_all(as.numeric)

out_heat_bin <- ifelse(out_heat >= 3, 4, ifelse(out_heat < 1.5, 1, 2))

colours = c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027")
col <- colorRamp2(breaks = c(1,2,4), colours)

Heatmap(out_heat, col = col)
Heatmap(out_heat_bin, col = col)
```

hg38 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_1_ena/03_CNV/pureCN_raw/normalDB_hg38.rds")
